vocabulary.meaning: stop (bus, tram, metro) · la fermata dell'autobus = the bus stop

vocabulary.meaning: to come by, to pass (a bus or train); to spend (time)
next · la prossima fermata = the next stop

vocabulary.meaning: to get off, to go down · scendere dal treno = to get off the train
taxi · i taxi (no change in the plural)

vocabulary.meaning: airport · all'aeroporto = at or to the airport
vocabulary.example: L'autobus per l'aeroporto parte dalla stazione.

vocabulary.meaning: underground, metro · la metro (short for la metropolitana)
